newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-London coffee due up, seen in wide range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-London coffee due up, seen in wide range.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Coffee is due higher on Thursday, but analysts see it keeping to a wide range.
Traders called benchmark September to open $70 higher.
The market was still stuck in a range, according to Adrian Haylor, analyst at Sucden. Nearby support was at $1,775 and the range went up to around $1,975, although he noted resistance at $1,895.
"There is scope for a move towards the upper end," he said. But resistance at $2,000 was strong. "At this stage I don't think it's going to break," he said.
"The days of 200 point moves up and down have gone for the time being," Haylor said. "The volatility's gone down."
"Mild weather in Brazil continues to dash any hopes of a swift recovery in coffee prices," brokers GNI said.
New York coffee futures ended higher and toward the day's peaks on Wednesday, bolstered by a late-session round of trade and local buying, dealers said.
